### Method 1: Import Memory & Preferences (Fastest)

Claude has a built-in import feature designed to pull your background, style, and instructions from ChatGPT.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX8BRY5KovhXFrI6oTj5iER_1oF7fJY7mpXuWYEU_IMcgWFavQFiWLqtWWL6b1O6i7mRp2QMXAzoZ01mSM_MoQtLX5obzAf_760JerLtCOKA3PjJxZzhM7j_6OTO4CJ9RfRdmmyYJmPeIs)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12zhOfP7wbw0bKVOntoHh6CZkLrJpXpNL5ghsZyT9EBBuaKl-WIm5VtEhoIgFsgg1XfVTQ_eSYXZ7_Wq13wYkmXv8asqkp--j8KgjiVQRr2nZ4EK43kCM6ypwQHZhpFgDmnaYLfx0UeUPDN1Sf6KtJW9ekR67hv3IBjXSspY8OOjhFpP)

	- Open [Claude](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHEIkXXMfMxSedxs_a72lV_ZGNDDpJLwPeoZu3gKD_Kh3j5XQ734MAf_13S4L6SjmhXb9j7la2fEBfuLvbXbwV4JzU1LDOVpoEeWLpfLA) , click your profile picture in the bottom-left corner, and go to **Settings**.
	- Select **Capabilities** , find **Memory** , and click **Start import**.
	- Copy the specialized prompt that Claude provides.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12zhOfP7wbw0bKVOntoHh6CZkLrJpXpNL5ghsZyT9EBBuaKl-WIm5VtEhoIgFsgg1XfVTQ_eSYXZ7_Wq13wYkmXv8asqkp--j8KgjiVQRr2nZ4EK43kCM6ypwQHZhpFgDmnaYLfx0UeUPDN1Sf6KtJW9ekR67hv3IBjXSspY8OOjhFpP)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX8BRY5KovhXFrI6oTj5iER_1oF7fJY7mpXuWYEU_IMcgWFavQFiWLqtWWL6b1O6i7mRp2QMXAzoZ01mSM_MoQtLX5obzAf_760JerLtCOKA3PjJxZzhM7j_6OTO4CJ9RfRdmmyYJmPeIs)
2. **Extract your memory from ChatGPT**:
	- Open [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXVSA3YC8WO-C0_MbzECG-I_iAl52lFlnjFFaUjg35vFmpTIkd7xlh5Dhhasd4HCUejyBav7EZ6t4isUAGwT3AHV01tH1_2NtU8MJs) and start a new conversation.
	- Paste the prompt copied from Claude and run it.
	- Once ChatGPT generates a summary of your background, preferences, and projects, copy that response.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX8BRY5KovhXFrI6oTj5iER_1oF7fJY7mpXuWYEU_IMcgWFavQFiWLqtWWL6b1O6i7mRp2QMXAzoZ01mSM_MoQtLX5obzAf_760JerLtCOKA3PjJxZzhM7j_6OTO4CJ9RfRdmmyYJmPeIs)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12zhOfP7wbw0bKVOntoHh6CZkLrJpXpNL5ghsZyT9EBBuaKl-WIm5VtEhoIgFsgg1XfVTQ_eSYXZ7_Wq13wYkmXv8asqkp--j8KgjiVQRr2nZ4EK43kCM6ypwQHZhpFgDmnaYLfx0UeUPDN1Sf6KtJW9ekR67hv3IBjXSspY8OOjhFpP)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXk4Z74bOZwtP8mPp2ZvCb_BDFFvBNgseEZLkfnFGPu8X_qBfV3kj0QW9YAJ3dYPwsQHtWZA1ubjPI-CjQvqi5Pa8069vmJZQsLSpsFf3ZKNAa-9bJOo4UVbnsRUPwlR8PNxlR)

	- Return to Claude's memory import screen, paste the text generated by ChatGPT, and click **Add to memory**.
